title: The Root Parliament

features.name: the-arguing-roots
features.desc-on-touch: Roots braiding and unbraiding in the dark, each one convinced of a different season. Their debate is the texture of argument itself.

features.name: the-root-chamber-where-voices-learn-to-diverge
features.desc-on-touch: Roots have learned to speak in parliament. Spring claims one root. Autumn claims another. They will never agree, and agreement is not their purpose.

features.name: the-season-sediment-layers
features.desc-on-touch: Soil stratified by argument. Each layer votes for a different time. The archive has learned to vote against itself.

features.name: the-root-memory-where-seasons-blur
features.desc-on-touch: You remember being grown, being planted, being seed. Roots know all seasons at once. Their parliament is the sound of that knowing.

inscription: the soil votes and votes and will never finish voting

file.name: Root_Parliamentary_Minutes_Autumn_Spring_Disputed.txt
file.note: A record of a debate that has not ended. Both sides are winning. Both sides have always been right.

reverie.title: REVERIE — forest dusk, learning to listen
narr: You kneel in the root-dark where Katita listens.
She has her ear against the soil. "Listen," she says.
"They are all arguing about the same year."
The roots move, and she moves her head to follow them.
The dark teaches you that argument is a form of intimacy.

exits.label: back upward to where all seasons bloom at once
deeper into the bedrock where seasons lose their names
toward the root-tangle where debate becomes silence
